item.title: No Ohio State president has exited as planned since 1981
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- With Ohio State's Walter "Ted" Carter resigning as university president this week, the university will not have had a president exit Ohio State into retirement since 1981. Carter, Ohio State's 17th president, resigned over the weekend due to "an inappropriate relationship with someone seeking public resources to support her personal business." [...]
